Light Up the Night at Navratri 2026 - Live Garba and Dandiya Night by Pancham Beats
Mark your calendars for the 15th of October, 2026, as Pancham Beats LLC brings you an unforgettable night of celebration and dance at the Navratri 2026 - Live Garba and Dandiya Night. Experience the joy of Navratri, one of the most vibrant festivals celebrated with great fervor and enthusiasm. Lose yourself in the rhythmic beats of Garba and Dandiya, traditional dance forms from the Indian state of Gujarat. This event is a perfect blend of Bollywood, Dance, and Religious festivities that caters to all Hindi and Gujarati speaking audience. So, dress in your vibrant ethnic best and join us in celebrating Navratri in a grand style.
Meet the Maestro - Dhawal Majmudar
At the heart of this musical extravaganza is the versatile artist, Dhawal Majmudar. With over a decade of experience in performing across the San Francisco Bay Area, Dhawal is a force to reckon with in the music industry. His musical mastery includes a wide range of genres from Garba, Dandiya, Indian Folk, Bollywood, Bhajans to Ghazals. Known for his entertaining voice impressions, most notably of the legendary Amitabh Bachchan, Dhawal's performances are always filled with energy and charisma. A man of many talents, Dhawal is ready to mesmerize you with his music at the Navratri 2026 - Live Garba and Dandiya Night.
Experience the Vibrancy at Shubham Halls
The Navratri 2026 - Live Garba and Dandiya Night will be held at the Shubham Halls, located at 1214 Apollo Way, Sunnyvale, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, Shubham Halls is an ideal venue for large gatherings and celebrations. Around the venue, you can enjoy a variety of Indian restaurants, perfect for those looking to indulge in some authentic Indian cuisine before or after the event. Parking is available at the venue for your convenience.
Grab Your Tickets Today!
Be a part of this grand celebration by securing your tickets today. Adult entry tickets are priced at $15.00 while kids under 5 can join in the fun for FREE. Don't miss out on this opportunity to immerse yourself in the vibrant culture and tradition of Navratri. Get your tickets now and get ready to dance the night away!
